---
title: "Mafalda shortlisted for the Vanguardia Ciència award"
date: 2026-06-13
categories: [Award, Press]
description: "Mafalda's work on diagnosing rare diseases with models of evolution was one of the finalists for the 2026 Premi Vanguardia Ciència."
---

Mafalda was one of the finalists for the 2026 Premi Vanguardia Ciència, the science award run by *La Vanguardia* and Fundació Catalunya La Pedrera, for the group's work on diagnosing rare diseases with generative models of evolution.

*La Vanguardia* published [a feature on her research](https://www.lavanguardia.com/ciencia/20260613/11563080/diagnosticamos-enfermedades-raras-analizando-millones-anos-evolucion.html) (in Spanish).

Read more about this work in the [popEVE](../../papers/2025-popeve/index.qmd) and [EVE](../../papers/2021-eve/index.qmd) summaries.
